title: Runtime quantum capability query
baseline_evidence: Build flag and unavailable stubs exist; no unified Scheme capability report found.
acceptance_criteria: A query reports build flag, simulator backend, ABI, supported operations and derivative modes; ON/OFF CI asserts each field without executing an unavailable operation.

title: Reproducible optional quantum packages
baseline_evidence: Opt-in source integration exists; this stream has not validated packaged ON builds.
acceptance_criteria: Clean Windows, Linux and macOS jobs install a pinned ON package, run Bell/VQE smoke tests, and verify OFF builds return documented unavailability.

title: Honest execution and entropy provenance
baseline_evidence: Source labels exist but some prose conflates simulated Bell tests with physical certification.
acceptance_criteria: Every result identifies classical simulator or named physical device; entropy output reports actual source and fallback events; no simulation is labelled device-independent certified entropy.

title: Moonlab ABI and revision manifest
baseline_evidence: CMake pins a commit while nearby comments/reference text mention other revisions.
acceptance_criteria: Generated manifest records exact dependency commit and ABI; intentional mismatches fail before allocation; release docs are generated from the same manifest.

title: Generational quantum handles
baseline_evidence: Opaque integer tables and destroy helpers exist; stale-handle reuse needs a specified contract.
acceptance_criteria: Allocate/free/reallocate fuzzing never lets a stale handle access a new state; double destruction is defined; invalid handles produce catchable errors under sanitizers.

title: Typed qubit ownership through public APIs
baseline_evidence: Linear Qubit exists, but state-handle plus integer-index wrappers do not establish full resource typing.
acceptance_criteria: Compile-fail tests cover duplicate use, escaping aliases and interprocedural returns; valid scoped gates compile; runtime state ownership agrees with the static qubit identity.

title: Uniform quantum error contract
baseline_evidence: C shim uses error codes/NaN and wrappers translate selected failures.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid counts, indices, angles, destroyed handles and allocation failures all produce documented catchable errors; no invalid case silently returns a plausible numeric result.

title: Dense ideal-state correctness gate
baseline_evidence: Dense state creation, gates, measurement and Z expectation have public wrappers and source tests.
acceptance_criteria: Exhaustively compare all exposed 1- and 2-qubit gates with independent complex matrices; norm and expectation errors stay below 1e-12 in float64 fixtures.

title: Seeded simulator replay
baseline_evidence: Measurement wrapper uses a process entropy context; caller-supplied seed is not exposed.
acceptance_criteria: A seed plus serialized program reproduces samples on the same version; different seeds pass distribution checks; deterministic replay is never advertised as physical entropy.

title: Backend conformance ledger
baseline_evidence: Source tests exist but no fresh complete native/VM/browser quantum matrix was run here.
acceptance_criteria: Publish operation-by-engine supported/refused/untested statuses tied to executable tests; zero unsupported cases silently succeed; include release hashes and test logs.

title: OpenQASM 3 export
baseline_evidence: No public circuit export API found in the inspected module/shim.
acceptance_criteria: Export a declared gate/measurement subset; an independent OpenQASM parser accepts 100 fixtures and simulation probabilities match within 1e-10.

title: OpenQASM 3 import
baseline_evidence: No public parser/import adapter found in the quantum surface.
acceptance_criteria: Parse the declared subset with source locations; reject pulse/unsupported dynamic constructs explicitly; imported Bell, QFT and adaptive fixtures match reference behavior.

title: QIR target profile
baseline_evidence: LLVM compilation alone is not a QIR emitter; none found in inspected quantum interface.
acceptance_criteria: Emit a named QIR profile with verified LLVM IR and required metadata; run at least 20 programs on an independent compatible executor.

title: Quil interchange adapter
baseline_evidence: No public Quil serializer/parser found in the quantum interface.
acceptance_criteria: Round-trip gates, classical memory and measurement for a documented Quil subset; preserve bit order and reject pulse annexes until implemented.

title: Typed circuit intermediate representation
baseline_evidence: Current public API mutates opaque simulator state directly rather than exposing circuit objects.
acceptance_criteria: Represent qubits, gates, parameters, measurements and dependencies with a versioned schema; validation catches dangling wires and parameter-type errors before execution.

title: Portable observable and Hamiltonian interchange
baseline_evidence: Pauli-string Hamiltonian construction exists; no general import/export schema found.
acceptance_criteria: Serialize arbitrary Pauli sums, units, constants and wire order; round-trip 50 fixtures with identical coefficients and expectation values within 1e-12.

title: Shot-result and bit-order schema
baseline_evidence: Single-qubit measurement returns an integer; no portable batch-result schema found.
acceptance_criteria: Specify endianness, register mapping, counts, shots, uncertainty and provenance; adapters pass asymmetric-bitstring tests that detect reversal errors.

title: Backend plugin contract
baseline_evidence: Moonlab is compiled into the shim; no public quantum backend plugin contract found.
acceptance_criteria: Two independent simulator adapters implement capability discovery, execute, sample and observe; unsupported operations fail consistently without implicit backend substitution.

title: PennyLane device integration
baseline_evidence: No PennyLane-facing device plugin found in inspected Eshkol quantum surface.
acceptance_criteria: A separately versioned plugin passes its declared device-conformance tests and a 20-case expectation/gradient comparison without copying parameters incorrectly.

title: Quantum array interchange
baseline_evidence: Quantum state is opaque; VQE parameters are marshalled through a dedicated context.
acceptance_criteria: Exchange complex amplitudes and parameter arrays through a documented C/Python boundary; shape, ownership, dtype and lifetime tests catch aliasing and precision loss.

title: Complete practical gate vocabulary
baseline_evidence: H, X, Y, Z, CNOT, RX, RY and RZ are exposed; many standard gates are not.
acceptance_criteria: Add S, T, CZ, SWAP and controlled rotations or verified decompositions; compare matrices including global-phase conventions and invalid-wire cases.

title: Controlled and adjoint circuit combinators
baseline_evidence: No general circuit modifier API is exposed.
acceptance_criteria: Controlled and inverse transforms compose over supported circuits; random unitary fixtures satisfy U-dagger times U within 1e-10 and measurement inversion is rejected.

title: Safe automatic uncomputation
baseline_evidence: Classical region memory does not implement quantum uncomputation.
acceptance_criteria: For a declared reversible subset, compiler-generated cleanup returns ancillas to zero and preserves output coherence; unsafe erasures fail static checking.

title: Ancilla allocation and reuse planner
baseline_evidence: State allocation exists, but no circuit-level ancilla liveness planner is exposed.
acceptance_criteria: Report peak live ancillas and verified reuse intervals; transformed circuits match references and never reuse an entangled live ancilla.

title: Measurement-dependent circuit control
baseline_evidence: Host Scheme can branch on measurement; portable in-circuit feedback representation is not established.
acceptance_criteria: Represent mid-circuit measurement, reset, conditionals and bounded loops; teleportation and repeat-until-success fixtures match simulator/reference distributions.

title: Topology-aware routing
baseline_evidence: No target connectivity/routing abstraction found in public quantum interface.
acceptance_criteria: Route 50 fixed circuits to line/grid/device graphs; every two-qubit operation is legal, semantics preserved, and swap overhead is reported.

title: Native-gate synthesis
baseline_evidence: Direct simulator gate calls do not form a target synthesis pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Compile arbitrary tested 1-/2-qubit unitaries to a declared basis with chosen error budget; verify achieved error and report gate count and synthesis time.

title: Local circuit optimization passes
baseline_evidence: No quantum pass-manager API found in exposed surface.
acceptance_criteria: Cancellation, rotation fusion and commuting passes preserve 100 random small-circuit unitaries within 1e-10; publish before/after depth and count.

title: ZX optimization interoperability
baseline_evidence: No ZX diagram adapter found in quantum surface.
acceptance_criteria: Export/import a defined Clifford+T subset to PyZX; certify equality or clearly report unverifiable cases; record T-count and extraction failures.

title: Proof-checked unitary rewrite kernel
baseline_evidence: General Eshkol proof types do not constitute verified quantum rewrite rules.
acceptance_criteria: Mechanize semantics and prove at least five implemented rewrites; generated optimizer only uses checked rules, with numeric tests as secondary evidence.

title: Density-matrix simulator adapter
baseline_evidence: Public binding exposes dense pure states, not density matrices.
acceptance_criteria: Bell-state partial trace gives maximally mixed marginals; trace and positivity tests pass; small noisy circuits match an independent density simulator within 1e-10.

title: Validated Kraus and noise channels
baseline_evidence: No public channel/noise-model constructor found.
acceptance_criteria: Implement depolarizing, dephasing and amplitude damping; validate completeness within tolerance and reject non-physical channel inputs.

title: Quantum trajectory simulation
baseline_evidence: No trajectory ensemble API found in public binding.
acceptance_criteria: Ensemble averages converge to density-matrix references with declared confidence intervals; logs record trajectory count, seeds and sampling error separately from solver error.

title: Lindblad time evolution
baseline_evidence: Moonlab integration references other engines; public module has no open-system solver.
acceptance_criteria: Damped two-level analytic solutions and independent solver fixtures agree under a documented tolerance; step refinement verifies convergence and trace preservation.

title: Stabilizer simulator backend
baseline_evidence: No tableau/stabilizer operations exposed in the binding.
acceptance_criteria: Execute Clifford circuits through a tested adapter; match exact small-system probabilities and run a 1000-qubit stabilizer fixture without exponential state storage.

title: Tensor-network simulation binding
baseline_evidence: Design names Moonlab CA-MPS/TDVP APIs but public module does not bind them.
acceptance_criteria: Expose bond/truncation controls with discarded-weight diagnostics; match small exact references and show convergence as bond dimension increases.

title: GPU-resident quantum state execution
baseline_evidence: Integration config disables optional Moonlab accelerators; general Eshkol GPU support does not prove this path.
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate actual device-resident gate execution and synchronization tests; report memory, correctness and end-to-end speed versus CPU including transfers.

title: Distributed quantum simulation
baseline_evidence: No multi-node quantum state partitioning API found in exposed binding.
acceptance_criteria: Run one reproducible distributed state-vector fixture on two nodes; compare checksum/observables to a serial reference and report communication-inclusive scaling.

title: Qudit state and gate support
baseline_evidence: Public API uses qubit counts and binary gates.
acceptance_criteria: Support dimension-3 registers and mixed-dimension validation; qutrit Fourier/controlled-shift fixtures preserve norm and match independent matrices.

title: Continuous-variable photonic model
baseline_evidence: Public API is qubit state-vector/VQE, with no Fock/Gaussian abstraction.
acceptance_criteria: Implement or adapt Gaussian/Fock operations; coherent/squeezed-state observables agree with references and cutoff-convergence reports quantify truncation error.

title: Preserve ideal VQE adjoint correctness
baseline_evidence: vqe-energy custom VJP and vqe-gradient plus adversarial source tests exist.
acceptance_criteria: On quantum-enabled releases, compare AD, direct VJP and central differences over random nonstationary points; maximum gradient error below 1e-6 and no unexplained zero gradients.

title: User-defined variational ansatz
baseline_evidence: Public VQE uses a fixed one-layer hardware-efficient ansatz.
acceptance_criteria: Users construct 3 distinct trainable circuit families; arbitrary parameter mapping is preserved and expectations/gradients match independent references.

title: Shot-based parameter-shift gradients
baseline_evidence: A native analytic fallback is documented, but user-controlled shot-based gradient execution is not exposed.
acceptance_criteria: Estimate eligible gate derivatives with shot budgets and confidence intervals; 95% interval coverage is checked over repeated seeds against analytic small cases.

title: General adjoint circuit differentiation
baseline_evidence: Adjoint path exists for default ideal VQE, not arbitrary exposed circuit objects.
acceptance_criteria: Differentiate user circuits with 1, 10 and 100 parameters; match parameter-shift references and publish peak memory/runtime as depth and width vary.

title: Second-order quantum derivative contract
baseline_evidence: Arbitrary-order host AD does not establish arbitrary higher-order derivatives through the opaque VQE primitive.
acceptance_criteria: Specify supported Hessian/JVP compositions; test symmetry and finite differences; unsupported nesting raises a named error rather than returning zero.

title: General quantum geometric tensor
baseline_evidence: vqe-qgt currently assumes four parameters and returns 4x4 entries.
acceptance_criteria: Accept variable parameter counts; compare to state-derivative references, test symmetry/positive semidefiniteness, and state gauge and regularization conventions.

title: Differentiation through noisy channels
baseline_evidence: Public VQE bridge describes ideal-state energy and gradients.
acceptance_criteria: Differentiate at least two parameterized CPTP channels; compare with density-matrix finite differences and distinguish stochastic estimator variance from numerical bias.

title: Batched parameter sweeps and gradients
baseline_evidence: Public VQE evaluator takes one parameter vector per call.
acceptance_criteria: Batch 32 independent parameter sets; outputs match serial runs, ordering is stable, and timing includes marshaling and device transfers.

title: Restartable hybrid optimizer workflow
baseline_evidence: vqe-optimize offers an iteration count with a fixed default optimizer; general state/checkpoint control is not exposed.
acceptance_criteria: Export optimizer state, RNG and parameters; an interrupted run resumes to the same seeded result, with loss/gradient/shot histories preserved.

title: Quantum derivative refusal and coverage manifest
baseline_evidence: Dedicated VQE checks exist; generic derivative coverage across new backends is not established.
acceptance_criteria: Every operation/backend/order combination is supported or explicitly refused; negative tests cover measurement branches, unsupported channels and nested AD without silent zeros.

title: General chemistry Hamiltonian import
baseline_evidence: Fixed H2/LiH/H2O constructors and arbitrary Pauli sums exist.
acceptance_criteria: Import a documented electronic-integral or Pauli dataset with basis, geometry and units; validate at least five small molecules against independent diagonalization.

title: Symmetry tapering and sector selection
baseline_evidence: Public Hamiltonian construction accepts an HF bitmask but no tapering transformation.
acceptance_criteria: Identify supported commuting symmetries; reduced and unreduced sector spectra agree on small fixtures; invalid sector requests are rejected.

title: Excited-state and spectral workflows
baseline_evidence: Public helpers focus on ground-state reference/VQE energy.
acceptance_criteria: Compute two excited energies and overlaps for small Hamiltonians with declared method; independent eigensolver agreement and orthogonality checks are mandatory.

title: Quantum phase estimation library
baseline_evidence: No public QPE combinator found in quantum module.
acceptance_criteria: Known eigenphase fixtures recover each phase to the requested bits; account for ancillas, controlled-evolution synthesis and failure probability.

title: Amplitude estimation library
baseline_evidence: No exposed amplitude-estimation routine found.
acceptance_criteria: Estimate a set of known Bernoulli amplitudes; observed confidence coverage matches declared guarantees and oracle-call counts include state preparation.

title: QAOA with explicit classical baseline
baseline_evidence: Public quantum layer exposes VQE but no QAOA constructor.
acceptance_criteria: Small MaxCut instances match exhaustive optimum bounds; report approximation ratio, shots and total time against named classical solvers without claiming generic advantage.

title: Hamiltonian time-evolution circuits
baseline_evidence: Gate wrappers do not expose a compositional simulation algorithm library.
acceptance_criteria: Trotter/Suzuki evolution matches matrix exponentials on small models; refinement demonstrates expected convergence and error budgets include synthesis.

title: Block encoding and quantum signal processing
baseline_evidence: No public block-encoding/QSP construction API found.
acceptance_criteria: For bounded small matrices, verify top-left block encoding and polynomial transformation numerically; report normalization, oracle and approximation costs.

title: Tomography and classical-shadow experiments
baseline_evidence: Z expectation exists; reconstruction/measurement-design workflows are not exposed.
acceptance_criteria: Reconstruct specified small states/observables with uncertainty intervals, record shot counts and test coverage over independent seeds.

title: Discrete-photon experiment adapter
baseline_evidence: No public linear-optics/Fock-state interface found.
acceptance_criteria: Run Hong-Ou-Mandel and a heralded small-circuit fixture through an adapter; preserve raw/postselected counts and model source/detector errors explicitly.

title: First physical gate-QPU adapter
baseline_evidence: Exposed Moonlab interface is a classical simulator; no QPU submission path found.
acceptance_criteria: Submit a validated small program to one named physical device, record job ID/calibration/shots and reproduce retrieval; mocked tests never count as hardware validation.

title: Device topology and calibration snapshot
baseline_evidence: No public physical-device model found.
acceptance_criteria: Version connectivity, basis gates, durations and calibration timestamp; compilation rejects incompatible circuits and records exactly which snapshot it used.

title: Durable asynchronous quantum jobs
baseline_evidence: Local simulator calls are synchronous and no quantum job handle API is exposed.
acceptance_criteria: Submission, polling, cancellation and restart recovery are idempotent; mocked failure tests cannot double-submit a chargeable job and preserve final provenance.

title: Execution and shot budget enforcement
baseline_evidence: No QPU cost/shot budget API found.
acceptance_criteria: A preflight policy caps shots, retries and estimated spend; tests show retries cannot exceed caps; actual usage reconciles against recorded jobs.

title: Pulse and timing representation
baseline_evidence: No public pulse/frame/waveform representation found.
acceptance_criteria: Represent frames, durations and waveforms with units; enforce target sample/timing limits; round-trip a documented pulse subset with no unit conversion ambiguity.

title: Neutral-atom geometry and waveform adapter
baseline_evidence: Public API has no atom positions, blockade model or analog program object.
acceptance_criteria: Validate inter-atom spacing, channel limits and waveform schedules against one device schema; compare Rabi and small Ising simulations with references.

title: Digital-analog program composition
baseline_evidence: Quantum module exposes gates and fixed VQE, not mixed analog blocks.
acceptance_criteria: Compose gate and Hamiltonian-evolution blocks with explicit units; ideal small-system results and parameter derivatives match an independent solver.

title: Hardware feedback latency contract
baseline_evidence: Host branching does not guarantee device-resident or bounded-latency feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Measure control round-trip distributions on one backend and declare limits; unsupported feedback is rejected, with no claim of hard real-time bounds from arena allocation.

title: Readout mitigation with uncertainty
baseline_evidence: No public physical measurement-calibration model found.
acceptance_criteria: Calibrate a small readout matrix; report corrected estimates, uncertainty and conditioning; held-out tests show when correction worsens results.

title: Error mitigation under a fixed budget
baseline_evidence: No ZNE/PEC experiment framework exposed.
acceptance_criteria: Implement one mitigation protocol with raw and corrected outputs; compare mean-squared error at equal total shots, including calibration overhead and failure regimes.

title: Logical-versus-physical qubit model
baseline_evidence: Qubit type and simulator count do not encode code distance or logical operations.
acceptance_criteria: Resource objects distinguish logical qubits, physical qubits, code distance and gate level; mixing incompatible levels fails validation.

title: Stabilizer-code construction library
baseline_evidence: No public QEC code constructor found.
acceptance_criteria: Generate repetition and distance-3/5 surface-code circuits; ideal syndromes and every single-Pauli injection match independently checked expectations.

title: Detector error model interchange
baseline_evidence: No detector/syndrome schema exposed.
acceptance_criteria: Export detector models for declared noise assumptions; an independent decoder consumes them and fault-injection checks preserve detector/observable mappings.

title: Decoder plugin and throughput harness
baseline_evidence: Moonlab design names decoder registries; Eshkol module does not expose them.
acceptance_criteria: Two decoders consume the same syndrome batches; publish logical error, latency percentiles and throughput on fixed seeds/hardware with no unmeasured real-time claim.

title: Logical error scaling experiments
baseline_evidence: No public code-distance/noise sweep workflow found.
acceptance_criteria: Sweep at least three code distances and noise rates with confidence intervals; fit suppression only in measured regimes and expose insufficient-statistics outcomes.

title: Clifford+T synthesis error budget
baseline_evidence: No fault-tolerant gate/resource compiler surface found.
acceptance_criteria: Lower supported rotations to Clifford+T with a declared synthesis bound; verify small unitaries and account separately for algorithmic, synthesis and physical error.

title: Magic-state factory resource model
baseline_evidence: No public distillation/factory model found.
acceptance_criteria: Compute physical-qubit/time estimates for named protocols under explicit input errors; reproduce a published small reference table and include parameter sensitivity.

title: Logical scheduling and lattice-surgery plan
baseline_evidence: No logical layout/schedule representation found.
acceptance_criteria: Compile a small logical workload into a legal schedule for one architecture model; report space-time volume and validate resource conflicts.

title: Fault-tolerant resource estimation adapter
baseline_evidence: No public estimator bridge found; language compilation alone is insufficient.
acceptance_criteria: Export a supported workload to an external estimator; preserve assumptions and compare physical qubits/runtime across at least three hardware/code scenarios.

title: Cross-layer resource and error budget ledger
baseline_evidence: No unified algorithm-to-physical cost ledger found.
acceptance_criteria: A chemistry or phase-estimation example records precision, success probability, logical operations, factories and physical resources without double-counting overhead.

title: Executable quantum documentation
baseline_evidence: Quantum examples/source tests exist but this stream did not execute every published example on every target.
acceptance_criteria: CI extracts all quantum examples, runs declared supported targets, and marks external hardware prerequisites; wrong expected outputs block release.

title: Quantum-aware diagnostics
baseline_evidence: Wrapper error messages exist; circuit source mapping and richer diagnostics are absent.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid wires, nonunitary gates, impossible ownership and unsupported target features report source spans and actionable reasons in 30 negative fixtures.

title: Circuit and state visualization
baseline_evidence: No public circuit object/visualizer found in the binding.
acceptance_criteria: Render circuits with parameter/measurement labels and small-state plots; snapshots preserve wire order and explicitly mark simulator-only state access.

title: Quantum profiling trace
baseline_evidence: No unified quantum compile/execute/transfer/shot trace exposed.
acceptance_criteria: Emit machine-readable spans for compilation, marshaling, transfers, execution and sampling; totals reconcile with wall time within documented instrumentation overhead.

title: Pinned reproducible experiment bundles
baseline_evidence: Dependency pinning exists; no universal experiment/result bundle schema was established here.
acceptance_criteria: Bundle program, dependency hashes, seeds, device snapshot, environment, raw results and analysis; a clean runner reproduces a seeded simulator experiment.

title: Differential quantum fuzzing
baseline_evidence: Source quantum tests exist; broad cross-tool randomized differential evidence is not established.
acceptance_criteria: Generate 1000 small valid circuits and compare independent engines with phase/shot-aware tolerances; minimize every mismatch into a retained regression.

title: Application benchmark protocol
baseline_evidence: Existing quantum microbenchmarks do not establish a 25-system application ranking.
acceptance_criteria: Freeze workload families, precision, hardware, seeds and time-to-solution metrics before measurement; publish failures and tuning budgets alongside successes.

title: Independent replication package
baseline_evidence: No independent replication of this proposed comparative protocol has occurred.
acceptance_criteria: A second team or isolated environment reruns the published bundle; discrepancies are logged and resolved before any leadership claim.

title: Quantum extension compatibility governance
baseline_evidence: General project contribution rules exist; quantum plugin/version promises are not established.
acceptance_criteria: Publish semantic-version and deprecation rules; two plugin versions run through a compatibility matrix and a deliberately incompatible ABI fails clearly.

title: Scientific claim-to-evidence registry
baseline_evidence: Existing docs mix implementation, historical design and performance/physical claims.
acceptance_criteria: Every public quantum capability claim links to source, passing test or measured report and declares scope; simulation, hardware, projection and open research are distinct fields.

title: Fault-tolerant chemistry beyond toy molecules
baseline_evidence: Public molecular constructors/VQE do not demonstrate practical fault-tolerant chemistry.
acceptance_criteria: Reproduce one small active-space reference end to end, then publish a larger-case resource estimate with basis/truncation/error budgets; independent chemistry review is required before a scientific claim.

title: End-to-end advantage for a materials workload
baseline_evidence: No matched classical-versus-quantum advantage experiment was established here.
acceptance_criteria: Pre-register a meaningful observable, precision and total-cost metric; beat tuned classical baselines with reproducible evidence, or publish the null result. Simulation speed alone cannot close this target.

title: Trainability-aware variational compiler
baseline_evidence: Native AD supplies derivatives but does not remove barren plateaus or shot complexity.
acceptance_criteria: On predefined circuit families, predict and measure gradient-variance scaling; compare initialization/ansatz strategies at equal budgets and publish counterexamples to claimed improvements.

title: Mitigation with defensible cost guarantees
baseline_evidence: No Eshkol result establishes mitigation benefit under general noise and equal sampling cost.
acceptance_criteria: Derive assumptions and overhead bounds for one method, then test equal-cost error across increasing depth; explicitly report regimes where mitigation loses.

title: Useful logical computation beyond memory experiments
baseline_evidence: No logical hardware execution path or result exists in the inspected binding.
acceptance_criteria: Execute a logical algorithm with repeated correction and compare to a defined physical implementation at equal task error; distinguish code-memory success from useful algorithmic advantage.

title: Verified adaptive quantum compilation
baseline_evidence: No proof links the quantum interface, dynamic control and backend lowering end to end.
acceptance_criteria: Formalize a bounded adaptive subset and prove selected lowerings preserve measurement semantics; publish assumptions and proof artifacts, with adversarial tests for unproved boundaries.

title: Learning from coherent experimental quantum data
baseline_evidence: Simulator-generated datasets do not establish coherent-data experimental advantage.
acceptance_criteria: Reproduce a small coherent-copy learning task with a physical-data protocol and explicit classical access model; compare sample complexity and account for state preparation/readout.

title: Physical device-independent entropy integration
baseline_evidence: Current simulated Bell/entropy layer is not a loophole-controlled physical Bell experiment.
acceptance_criteria: Consume authenticated physical experiment records with stated independence assumptions, finite-size entropy bounds and extractor parameters; simulation-only mode must be incapable of claiming certification.

title: Distributed quantum network programming
baseline_evidence: No quantum network, entanglement-distribution or remote-state API is exposed.
acceptance_criteria: Implement a simulator protocol with loss, fidelity and classical latency, then validate one hardware-linked entanglement task; report end-to-end success rates and assumptions.

title: Reproducible frontier resource co-design
baseline_evidence: No end-to-end hardware/code/algorithm Pareto study is exposed in Eshkol.
acceptance_criteria: Reproduce a published resource scenario, vary algorithm/code/hardware assumptions, and publish non-dominated cost/error tradeoffs with sensitivity and independent checks; estimates remain projections.
